questions.question_text: A square tile has area $169$ cm$^{2}$. Four of these tiles are laid in a row, edge to edge. How long is the row?

options.why: Found the side length of one tile but did not multiply by the four tiles.
Found the side length and doubled it instead of multiplying by four.
Multiplied the area by $4$ instead of finding the side length first.

questions.solution_text:
$\sqrt{169}=13$, so each tile has side length $13$ cm.
$4\times 13$
$=52$
The row is $52$ cm long.
